_comment: Template. `swarm grind /path/to/repo` copies this to config.json and fills in repo/test_cmd/python/base_branch. Edit config.json, not this file.

editor_wallet._comment: Dollars the Cursor/VS Code extension may spend on paid models when no free model answers a question. The swarm daemon never touches this: it is free-models-only unless allow_paid is set. Spending is recorded in ~/.flint/wallet.json and checked before every request.

prov._comment: Provisioning hooks the swarm runs in each fresh worktree before the test gate, so a bare checkout (fresh codespace, new laptop) reaches green without hand setup. Hooks run unsandboxed (they must install deps) but only in temp + package-cache writable dirs. `swarm init <repo>` writes configs/<slug>.json with a prov block filling in any of these that apply. Each hook runs exactly once per worktree, in list order; a failing hook fails the attempt with its output.
